propositions: AGENTS.md currently makes an unconditionally false claim that symbol tools reliably find all references; LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced via string literals like monkeypatch.setattr()
LSP index staleness causes reported line numbers to diverge from the working tree after recent edits, requiring grep verification for current positions

A decision table must replace the bare tool preference, mapping three distinct use cases (semantic symbol references, string-literal names, current line numbers) to appropriate tools (Serena, grep, grep)
The string-literal blind spot must be documented explicitly with monkeypatch.setattr as the concrete example that LSP symbol tools cannot detect
The stale-index caveat must be named with guidance to trust the working tree over LSP-reported line numbers after edits
Documentation changes must remain lean per AGENTS.md's own standing instruction, keeping supporting evidence in docs/ rather than inline
